description: This file defines a singly linked list implementation in Kotlin, including methods to add, remove, retrieve size, and access elements by index, along with a nested node class and a helper function to find the tail node.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A class implementing a singly linked list with basic operations such as add, remove, size, and get.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A private nested class representing a node in the linked list, holding data and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Private method to unlink a node from the list.
